steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Guns? Mercenaries?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: What are you babbling about?

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: I'm telling the truth, Boss! They've got huge guns! They killed Jarman!

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Mercenaries with big guns? Are they Sankta?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Are you telling me you blew your mission over four Sankta?

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: I don't think they're Sankta... probably...?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: They're not Sankta but they're mercs carrying around big guns?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: If you're gonna lie to me, at least make it believable.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: He's telling the truth.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: What do you mean he's telling the truth?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: He's telling the truth. They were heavily armed, but they really weren't Sankta.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Jarman took one in the brain, but I didn't see an arrow or a bolt. Sarkaz aren't that weak.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: These ones weren't part of your plan.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Having to deal with a bunch of fully armed mercenaries was not in the contract, boss, we need a raise.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: And where are they now?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: They're not in the Infected quarter anymore. Our men are looking for them, but we haven't seen any major movements. They should still be in the area.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: How's the old bastard doing?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Your father's people are tough. Especially that little sister of yours.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We bumped off some of their fighters, but we haven't been able to breach the manor perimeter.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Your scientist's monsters are doing good work out there, but your casters suck. We lost a lot of them already, without getting much for them.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Those are already the best money can buy.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Until your boss is willing to send us a caster, you're in no position to complain.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Then get your scientist to cook up some more monsters.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Or change tactics. That mansion is a fortress, and a direct attack isn't going to work. And it's not like your sister is an easy target either.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: What about the old bastard himself? Is he still holed up in the house?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I haven't seen your father yet. No sign of him at all since we showed up.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Hahaha... I knew it.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: I knew something happened to him!

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Keep watching the manor. Tell me as soon as you've got news.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What about the 'change our tactics' part? You're getting ahead of yourself.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Call it a Sarkaz mercenary's intuition. The longer you drag things out, the more chances they have to go wrong.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: I have a contingency plan. I just need time to put it together.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Confident as I am in the results of my experiments, the look on your face tells me you don't share my assessment.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Come, tell me, where have things gone wrong this time?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: I need progress from you.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Would you like to offer something a little more constructive? Or is your pointless needling all you have?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: I gave you enough corpses. I need at least twenty monsters.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Originiutants.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: These 'monsters' are Originiutants. They have a name.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Mutants, Originiutants, why should I care what they're called?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Give me more monsters.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: I gave you so many already. Did you get them all killed so quickly?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: I'm curious... How are your minions using the Originiutants? Do they rely on your 'Originium Arts'?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: What is it exactly? Super powers? Occult mysticism? Magic? Where does it come from?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Come, satisfy my curiosity. I must speak with your 'casters'.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Just do your job, egghead.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: You don't need to be thinking about Originium Arts right now.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Once we're done here, you'll have plenty of time for your own research.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: (Russian) I have very little confidence in your project.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: But speaking of time, did I not tell you? Yours is, in fact, limited.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: The lifespan of these Originiutants won't exceed one week. Whatever it is you have to do, you'll have to do it quickly.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: What are you trying to pull?!

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: This is the price for your lack of patience.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: You want the Originiutants produced quickly, you want them tremendously powerful, and at the same time you want them to have no weaknesses?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Do you truly believe such a thing is possible?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: I told you. No tricks, egghead.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: I'm busy. I have no time to joke with you.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: If you are so dissatisfied with my work, I suggest you take matters into your own hands. Use your own ingenuity to solve these genetic engineering complications that I, as a professional, can't solve in so little time.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Of course, you could bring me more materials, give me more time, and make your own contributions to this vapid family drama you're putting on.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Science is fair. You always have a choice.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: That's enough of your slippery talking.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Get back to work, egghead. Don't expect any mercy out of me if you fail.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: The price of failure is a slow and miserable death. I'm a man of my word.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Hah hah hah. When you put it like that, what else can I say?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Good luck, my friend.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There's so much smoke and chaos. Don't even need to get close to know what's going on.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Never expected a riot of this scale here...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Butting our horns in is sure to cause problems.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...I'm back.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Oh? What's the situation?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...It's out of control. There's constant fighting around a mansion on the north side of town. Looks like mercenaries on one side.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Things are even worse outside the manor. Bloodstains and collapsing houses everywhere.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: There's infected sand beasts scurrying through the alleyways, and there's a lot of them.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If it's gotten that bad, where's the Sargon military? The Lord Ameer's forces?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: There are some armed guards in that manor on the north side, but I didn't see any other Sargon soldiers.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So it's been like this for two days? Then I wonder if the watchman at the safehouse is okay...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It doesn't look good.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Let's not jump to conclusions.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...In other news, I found the safehouse.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Some people have taken up guarding it, but they're not Rhodes Island personnel.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: It's been occupied by the mercenaries?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No... not exactly. They don't look like typical mercs.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Their defensive positioning is extremely specialized. They have ambush killzones, traps, and decoys all set up.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Most importantly, they've got a lot of townsfolk in that safehouse.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Townsfolk? Just what kind of people do they have guarding the safehouse?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: They look pretty much like you. They've got guns.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Guns? Blacksteel mercenaries?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: They don't have any obvious markings on them. I can't say for sure they're Blacksteel.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Armed professionals stripped of any identifying markings... with guns.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oof... my head hurts.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: There are a lot of forces at work in this town.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: We can rule out a bandit raid.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: And if the Lord Ameer's forces are missing, it's not an act of war.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: The situation here... Far more complicated than I thought.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If they're willing to protect civilians in the middle of a riot, they can't exactly be evil.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Maybe we should try to make contact?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Let's be careful. There are a lot of possibilities here, even if we just look at them protecting the townsfolk.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I just hope they're the type you can reason with.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: No good. I can't make sense of it.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: This thing looks like a circuit board, but it's totally different from any circuit I've ever seen.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: If you gave me a month and a technical manual, I'm still not sure I could figure it out.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Screw it. I'm going to stand guard upstairs. I've been squatting so long my back is sore.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Good hustle, Lord.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No good?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: None of us have ever seen anything like the tech inside this comms equipment.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: I don't think we're going to be able to get it working.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You wouldn't know it from the outside. It looks like your typical transmitter.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Just like with the van back there, the energy they use in this world is unique. All their technology is based on this stuff called Originium.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: You're still studying that communicator, huh?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Originium comms equipment uses some really complicated tech. Rhodes Island always had to send engineering casters out to maintain it. I'm not surprised you can't fix it.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You said before you used this device to send out a distress signal?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Oh... I'm not sure if the signal actually got through.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: When the rioters attacked the safehouse, I hit the communicator as quick as I could. But they broke in before I got to talk to anyone.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Everything happened so fast, I could barely speak... It could be the Rhodes Island operator who took the call couldn't even hear me.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: So the cavalry isn't coming.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I was never waiting for the cavalry.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: You don't look worried at all.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You could say we're pretty used to fighting without backup.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Wow. I'm thinking if you had shown up just a little later, I'd be spending the rest of my life in a wheelchair.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Or maybe a coffin.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: All I can say is thanks.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Not necessary. You've done a lot to help the civilians yourself.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Well, I wouldn't make a big deal out of that. Treating the Infected is kind of Rhodes Island's business. Hahaha...

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: ...Even if I'm just a reserve Logistics Operator serving as a doorman.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Treating...? Does that mean there's medical supplies here?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: But what are these weapons for?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Oh, well...

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Rhodes Island is mainly a pharmaceutical company, but this safehouse doesn't actually offer any treatment services.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Safehouses are mostly to provide combat operators with supplies, equipment, weapons and stuff when they're out on missions.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Right......

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Hold on. What's this?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Is this a grenade launcher?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Grenade?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Oh, my. Is this a landmine?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: And you've got all kinds.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: ...I thought the people here didn't use thermal weapons.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The structure of this grenade launcher is a little strange.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: There's no propellant charge for the grenades. Does it use compressed gas?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Look, here's a model using hydraulic springs.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Be careful! That box is full of Originium explosives! It's dangerous.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Mr. Occphen, do you have ammunition for small arms here?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Small arms...? Do you mean guns? Oh, are you asking about etched ammo?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: We wouldn't usually have anything that valuable in a safehouse like this. Rhodes Island combat personnel rarely use guns.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Can we use these explosives?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Just be careful. Originium explosives are very dangerous.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: They used to only be for combat operators.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: But you look like you know what you're doing. I won't stop you.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Thank you very much.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: What about these? What are these wild looking parts for?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Backup casting units. Don't break them.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Casting units...?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Must be for that 'Originium Arts' stuff.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Originium Arts is the technique that lets them throw those fireballs?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: We're getting into the weeds here. I'm no caster.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: But Originium Arts comes in all kinds of flavors. Every caster has his own specialty.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Would the engineering casters you mentioned before be one of those?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Huh? Have you never seen Arts before?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Well... we haven't seen much.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: But how? You've got guns. Aren't you casters?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: A gun user who can't use Originium Arts? Now that's rare.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Occphen, your leg hasn't healed yet. I don't want you walking around.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: I'm fine, I've got my crutches. I can walk a few steps.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Doctor, how are the patients doing down there?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I've got most of the wounded stabilized, thanks to the medical supplies here.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You don't look so hot. Are you okay?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I just haven't slept at all. I'll be fine.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You need rest. We'll be in big trouble if we lose our only doctor.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll be careful.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Speaking of Originium Arts.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Don't they have some kind of magic where you say a spooky incantation and there's a big flash of light and... PRESTO! You're all healed up?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Erm...

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: What are you talking about? Hahaha...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: No, then? What about like a healing potion that you drink it and all your wounds close right up? None of that either?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: That's the stuff of sci-fi novels.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: There are Arts that can heal wounds, but they're a very difficult type of Arts to master.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Before you can master healing Arts, you first have to have a complete understanding of medical science, you have to know the anatomical structures of all the different races, things like that...

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Also, most healing Arts users can only stop bleeding or speed up wound recovery.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: These Arts are very useful on the operating table, but in my experience they're no substitute for real medical skill.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Doctor, can you use Arts?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I have a little knowledge... not very useful though.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: That's boringly realistic... *sigh*.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: To think a world with magic could be so inconvenient.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Hold up, did you just say 'sci-fi novels'?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Now I'm extra curious what your world's sci-fi novels talk about.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Would we find a bookstore in a bigger city? Maybe some history books too? Are books expensive?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I've gotten myself all worked up now.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: You're a weird bunch.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Where are you from anyway? Columbia? Victoria?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: You talk like you're Victorians, but like from a couple decades ago...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Well... I'm not really sure how to answer that one.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Miss Cohen and her friends came from very far away. From a place where Oripathy doesn't even exist.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: What??

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: ...Yeah, that.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: A country with no Oripathy? Really?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: No Oripathy, no Infected, that means no discrimination? A place with no hatred, where everyone's equal?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Lordy loo. What kind of paradise is that?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: ...Alright then. Your faces say it all. Just pretend I never asked...

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: We're under attack!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Sitrep!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: This is just the first wave. They have us surrounded.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: They were probing us with those earlier strikes.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: We've got more incoming!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Your traps?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: All good!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Watch your explosives.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Blitz, keep an eye on the left flank. Don't let them get the drop on us.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Lord, conserve your ammo!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: No problem. Let them come.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Watch for surprise attacks!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let's see what they've got.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Here they come!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Hold your fire... let them get a little closer.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Nine o'clock!

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Lord, the enemy's up, dead ahead!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Enemy down!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: These big guys with the horns are tough. Go for headshots!

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Ash! Over there!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What is that?!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Lord! Be careful!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: (Russian profanity)!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Alexsandr!!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I'm okay!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Don't worry about me! Hold the line!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What on earth is this!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Watch out for those mutants! Light cover's no good!!

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: That's a proper formation. Those four know what they're doing.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Sounds like gunfire... No... Those are more intense shots. That's a big, rapid-fire gun.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: They're surrounded.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It's the same mercenaries who were attacking the manor.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Those monsters remind me of what we saw in Lungmen.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The 'Host' and the 'Herd.'

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But they're not really the same.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Mercenaries carrying big guns and mercenaries commanding mysterious monsters...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: The situation is changing. And the balance is about to break.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...What do we do?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Don't hestiate. Prepare for battle.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Those vile beings who drivie this kind of monsters into battles deserve not a single bit of mercy.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Roger.
